items.name: Root Complex
items.depicts: A wide magenta-framed enclosure with five horizontal white and cyan bus lanes converging on a central white-bordered magenta core.

items.name: Crossbar Matrix
items.depicts: A magenta-framed grid where four vertical white lines intersect three horizontal cyan bus bars.

items.name: Descriptor Ring
items.depicts: Concentric magenta and cyan pixel rings surrounding a solid white central hub.

items.name: BAR Window
items.depicts: A white-framed dark horizontal housing containing five alternating cyan and magenta vertical register blocks.

items.name: Eye Opener
items.depicts: A small magenta-bordered black rectangle with a single horizontal cyan signal bar centered inside.

items.name: MSI-X Table
items.depicts: A cyan-bordered black rectangle containing four tall vertical vector columns alternating white and magenta.

items.name: Differential Pair
items.depicts: Two parallel full-width horizontal stripes, one cyan above and one magenta below, separated by a narrow gap.

items.name: IOMMU Gate
items.depicts: A white-bordered square enclosing a smaller magenta square frame around a solid black center.

items.name: Bus Flit
items.depicts: A tiny 7-by-2-pixel horizontal magenta streak with a two-pixel white leading tip, centered in a mostly empty 26x22 frame.

items.name: Framed Flit
items.depicts: A tiny 6-by-3-pixel magenta core enclosed in a one-pixel white border, centered in a mostly empty 26x22 frame.
